newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs flagging, support at 136.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs flagging, support at 136.00.

text.p: The upside momentum to September BTPs is flagging, technical analysts said on Thursday, but any setback should find fairly solid support at 136.00.
Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst near Cambridge, noted the formation of a shooting star on candlestick charts on Wednesday, giving a bearish signal for the market.
A bearish shooting star is formed when a contract opens and closes around the same level, but spikes higher intra-day.
"The market is overstretched. I think 136.70 will be the upper limits of any move today," said Gifford.
By 0750 GMT, September BTPs were down 0.34 at 136.22.
Gifford said a solid wedge of support at 136.00 should hold the market on Thursday, with any sharper correction put off until at least next week.

"The downside is greater than the upside at the moment but there won't be a serious correction yet," she said. "It's running out of steam so possibly at the beginning of next week it could start to correct more severely."

But Gifford said compared with the overbought levels last year, the market was not dramatically overextended. "So it may just consolidate," she said. By 0800 GMT, the 14-day Relative Strength Index was at 74 percent versus 84 percent last October.
Analysts at an Italian bank in London agreed weakness on Thursday could see a test of 136.00, which they deemed a buying opportunity.
They put the next support at 135.84/60 then 135.20. Charts show the market hit a high of 135.84 on July 4 and 135.60 on July 3.
To the upside, they said resistance would come in at 136.85/94 ahead of 137.05.
By 0810 GMT, September Eurolira was down 0.06 at 93.34.
